name: api-express
author: marlon-chaviano
title: API with Express
description: A REST API with Express 5 and TypeScript: input validation with Zod, security headers, centralized error handling and tests with Vitest and Supertest.

verify.command: {{pm}} run typecheck && {{pm}} run test && {{pm}} run build

instructions:
## How to work here

- One router per resource in `src/routes/`, mounted in `src/app.ts`. `createApp()` never listens, so tests use it directly with Supertest.
- Validate every body, query and param with a Zod schema (`schema.parse`): a `ZodError` becomes a 400 in the central error handler.
- Express 5 forwards thrown errors and rejected promises to the error handler: don't wrap handlers in try/catch just to call `next`.
- Never return stack traces or internal messages to clients; log them on the server.
- Start with `npm run dev`. Before finishing: `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`.
